verdict.rationale: Windmill's flow builder documents conditional branches ('Branch one') and a 'Branch all' mode that runs every branch, inside a low-code flow orchestrator. That covers conditional and multi-path branching. Filters, explicit parallel execution of those branches in the visual builder, and how branch results merge back into a single path are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented filter steps, explicit parallel execution of branch-all paths, documented merge/join of branch outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can branch a workflow with conditions, filters, and parallel paths that merge back together

citations.quote: Branches allow to split the execution of the flow based on a condition.
Branch all: all the branches will be executed.
An orchestrator for assembling these functions into efficient, low-latency flows, using either a low-code builder or YAML
